rules.title: Berkeley rent control (Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance) – fully covered units
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, to single-family homes whose current tenancy began before 1996, and to rooming houses. New construction with a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes with tenancies starting on or after Jan 1, 1996, most condominiums, and certain HUD-subsidized units are only partially covered (no rent control).
rules.coverage_conditions: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980 (no rent control for units built and receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980); single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996; rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented individually under separate leases). Includes units with Section 8 vouchers, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME and similar subsidies.
rules.exemptions: No rent control for: new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes with tenancy beginning on or after Jan 1, 1996; most condominiums; Section 202 and Section 811 units; Rental Supplement/Section 8 LMSA/project-based Section 8 units in projects with HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgages. Fully exempt: 'Golden Duplex' owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied; units where owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant and lived there when tenancy began; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties with an ADU where either unit is owner-occupied; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Tenancy start date (single-family homes before 1996; ADU properties after Nov 7, 2018); condominium status; owner occupancy (Golden Duplex, shared kitchen/bath, ADU); government subsidy type and HUD mortgage status; rooming-house configuration.

rules.title: Berkeley just cause for eviction coverage
rules.requirement: Landlords must have just cause to evict tenants in units covered by Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance, including partially covered units such as post-1980 new construction, single-family homes, and condominiums.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully and partially covered units: pre-1980 multifamily units, single-family homes (any tenancy start date), rooming houses, new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, most condominiums, and subsidized units listed in the guide.
rules.exemptions: 'Golden Duplex' owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied; units where owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant and lived there when tenancy began; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties with an ADU where either unit is owner-occupied; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Owner occupancy (Golden Duplex, shared kitchen/bath, ADU properties); tenancy start date for ADU exemption; university housing or nonprofit cooperative status.

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords of fully and partially covered units under Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance must pay interest on tenants' security deposits.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully and partially covered units: pre-1980 multifamily units, single-family homes, rooming houses, post-June 1980 new construction, most condominiums, and subsidized units listed in the guide.
rules.exemptions: 'Golden Duplex' owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied; units where owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant and lived there when tenancy began; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties with an ADU where either unit is owner-occupied; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Owner occupancy (Golden Duplex, shared kitchen/bath, ADU properties); tenancy start date for ADU exemption; university housing or nonprofit cooperative status.
